findings.issue: The RE failed to report all DLAs, including those of the LSPs, on the CIMS portal.
findings.doc_evidence: Only the bank's own app, Vasant Loans, has been reported on the RBI CIMS portal. The three partner LSP apps are not reported because they belong to the partners.

findings.issue: The RE did not complete the reporting of all DLAs on the CIMS portal by June 15, 2025.
findings.doc_evidence: The three partner LSP apps are not reported because they belong to the partners. A fourth partner app, StudyCash, went live last month. The bank will add it to its records at the next annual review.
